meta.name: brainstorming
meta.description: You MUST use this before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, or modifying behavior. Explores user intent, requirements and design before implementation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编码前梳理需求与设计意图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在动手写代码前总想先理清思路
copy.tagline_en: Clarify requirements and design before coding
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to think before you code

howto.what: 在开始任何创意工作前，Claude 会先通过对话了解你的意图、需求和设计，然后提出 2-3 种方案并推荐一种，最后写出设计文档，等你批准后才开始实现。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 创建新功能、修改行为或做任何创造性工作时，它会自动启动这个流程。

say.text: 我想给应用加一个用户登录功能，帮我设计一下。
say.note: Claude 会先问清楚需求，再给出设计方案。

say.text: 帮我改进这个页面的布局，让它更易用。
say.note: Claude 会先了解当前问题，再提出改进方案。

howto.what_en: Before any creative work, Claude explores your intent, requirements, and design through dialogue, proposes 2-3 approaches with a recommendation, presents the design for approval, writes a spec document, and only then proceeds to implementation.
howto.when_en: Triggered automatically when you ask Claude to create features, modify behavior, or do any creative work.

say_en.text: I want to add a login feature to my app. Help me design it.
say_en.note: Claude will ask clarifying questions and propose a design.

say_en.text: Improve this page layout to make it more user-friendly.
say_en.note: Claude will first understand the issues, then suggest improvements.
